name: length_interleave
prelude:
def interleave : List α → List α → List α
  | [], ys => ys
  | x :: xs, ys => x :: interleave ys xs
termination_by xs ys => xs.length + ys.length
statement:
theorem length_interleave (xs ys : List α) :
    (interleave xs ys).length = xs.length + ys.length
proofs:
induction xs, ys using interleave.induct with
  | case1 ys => simp [interleave]
  | case2 x xs ys ih => simp [interleave, ih]; omega
  have bounded (n : Nat) : ∀ (as bs : List α), as.length + bs.length = n →
      (interleave as bs).length = as.length + bs.length := by
    induction n using Nat.strongRecOn with
    | ind n ih =>
      intro as bs h
      cases as with
      | nil => simp [interleave]
      | cons a as =>
        have step := ih (bs.length + as.length) (by simp at h; omega) bs as rfl
        simp [interleave, step]
        omega
  exact bounded _ xs ys rfl
strategies: Functional induction following interleave and its argument swaps.
Strong induction on the combined list lengths via a bounded helper.
